story.title: Anthropic's Claude gets expanded compute capacity via SpaceX Colossus data centre deal
story.summary: Anthropic's Claude AI has secured access to compute capacity from SpaceX's Colossus data centre facility, a move that has allowed Anthropic to relax previously tight usage limits on its models. The arrangement means Claude users will encounter fewer rate limits and capacity constraints, improving day-to-day reliability for enterprise and consumer users. The deal underscores how AI labs are increasingly turning to non-traditional infrastructure partners to meet surging compute demand.
